d2b.name: data2bids
d2b.summary: AI question answering for construction bid teams. It connects to Google Drive, digitizes PDFs, drawings, spreadsheets and photos, and answers with the source file and page.

d2b.facts.v: Full-stack engineer. 1,400+ commits in the codebase.
Python, FastAPI, React, TanStack Router, Azure (AKS, SQL, Blob, Service Bus), GraphRAG, FAISS

d2b.imageAlt: data2bids home page with the headline AI Answers From Your Bid Data

d2b.parts.title: Drive sync
d2b.parts.body: Read-only Google Drive connection. Teams keep their folders where they are.

d2b.parts.title: Document pipeline
d2b.parts.body: OCR, chunking, embeddings and GraphRAG run in a queue-driven worker on Kubernetes, scaled by queue depth.

d2b.parts.title: Cited answers
d2b.parts.body: Questions in plain language. Every answer points to the file and page it came from.

d2b.parts.title: Tenant isolation
d2b.parts.body: Every query is scoped to a company. An MCP server exposes the same projects to AI assistants over OAuth.

pc.name: Playchive
pc.summary: A home for your gaming life. Organize a backlog, track what you play, review it and write about it. The web app and the mobile app share one backend.

pc.facts.v: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind 4, Expo, Convex, Clerk
IGDB, with an incremental sync plan that stays inside API and database quotas
